messages:
maria: heads up :rotating_light: after the RBAC refactor deployed yesterday I see fallback roles granting access across org-silos. audit shows KMS unwrap attempts from workspace B on keys owned by workspace A. anyone triaging?

devon: on it. can you paste the log snippet and any request ids? who performed the unwrap?

maria: pasted below, scrubbed ids:
```
2026-04-06T14:05:12Z INFO auth: policy_eval result=ALLOW via fallback_role=project_admin_fallback principal=svcacc-legacy@workspace-b request_id=req_01GxYk... action=kms:Decrypt key=projects/workspace-a/keys/ks-78 unwrap_attempt=true
2026-04-06T14:05:15Z INFO kms: UnwrapFailed error=AccessDenied request_id=req_01GxYk...
```

sec-bot: automated alert: policy_evaluation anomaly detected. correlated commit=84b3c9d (rbac-service) — new fallback rule added to handle legacy project migrations. severity=high.

jules: that fallback was intentionally added for legacy projects but the matching condition forgot to check `workspace_affinity`. if the mapping service returns null we currently fall through to fallback_role. looks like workspace-affinity returned null for several migrated projects yesterday.

ashley: agree we should flip the fallback off in prod immediately. @devon can ops toggle the feature flag? also we need to check audit-log retention and whether any unwraps succeeded. :lock:

ops-bot: action: feature-flag-update performed at 1710891280 by ops-user. changed `rbac.disable_fallback=true`. smoke tests passed.

maria: counts down from ~18 unwrap attempts to 2 after flag. those 2 were denied but still show KMS Unwrap logs. will start key rotation plan if any success entries pop up. adding this to incident board.

devon: opening incident thread and CVE-triage placeholder. will run membership queries to enumerate affected projects and start targeted key-rotate for keys with Deny->Allow windows. tagging Sec and SRE.

maria: thanks. follow-up items: 1) postmortem on mapping race, 2) tighten fallback matcher to require workspace_id equality, 3) audit retention check + export for regulators, 4) rollout safer feature flag pattern.

ashley: noted. I'll own rollout changes and tests.

sec-bot: note: created incident-ticket INC-2026-0413-17 (owner=devon) and scheduled emergency rotation checklist.
